method: Read-only Ghidra instruction captures via porting/material_pipeline/view_original_probe.py in /tmp/atmosphere-fields{,2,3}; no program save. SHA-256 windows below independently extracted from current mapped image. Ghidra project bookkeeping changed during open/close.

near_depth.original_assignment: 0x1444fce2a..0x1444fce6e compares float32 0x145a38abc (approximately 1e-5) with [RBX+0x2ac]. If COMISS does not set carry, stores (1.0 - [RBX+0x2b8]) / [RBX+0x2a8] to [RBX+0xd30]; otherwise stores [RBX+0x2b8]. Follow instruction flags for unordered values.
near_depth.copy_to_view: 0x1434c5e0f..15 invokes 0x143475750 with source RDX and destination RCX. Inside it 0x143475ddd..e9 copies source+0xd30 to destination+0xd30; the same destination later initializes +0x4e20. Helper 0x143579e9e reads [RCX+0xd30].
near_depth.semantic_comparison: Current Engine SceneView.cpp:594-612 derives View.NearClippingDistance from projection matrix M[2][3], M[3][2], M[2][2] with exactly the two corresponding formulas and threshold. This is strong structural evidence that original +0xd30 is NearClippingDistance; matching original layout of +0x2ac/+0x2b8/+0x2a8 to those projection entries and actual instance/callchain is not independently proven here.
near_depth.missing: Trace original construction and matrix writes to establish the source projection layout and actual source-to-helper instance if an unconditional field alias is required.

volume.original_producer: 0x1435675ee loads address 0x146713a20 (UTF-16 View.SkyAtmosphereCameraAerialPerspectiveVolume); 0x1435675fa takes address [R13+0x4e20] as R9, then 0x143567619 calls 0x143a94270. Same function at 0x1435675e4 invokes the allocator for adjacent +0x4e28 with a 2D LUT descriptor, whereas the +0x4e20 descriptor is 3D and labeled UnknownTextureVolume.
volume.original_consumer: 0x143579e34 checks [RCX+0x4e20] against zero and outputs float 0 or 1. 0x1434efe8c also loads this field and if nonzero reads its +0x10.
volume.semantic_comparison: Current SkyAtmosphereRendering.cpp:1024-1031 allocates the named aerial perspective volume into the view field using the render target pool; lines 300-316 use field nullness for ApplyCameraAerialPerspectiveVolume. Original string, address, allocation call, and helper nullness identify +0x4e20 as the corresponding pooled volume reference.
volume.missing: Original allocator 0x143a94270 assignment behavior and runtime instance selection were not traced; use the original field nullness, not assumed availability based on current renderer, when connecting the helper.
